title: S93 later notes: gate walk with repeated reviewer rows; environment-dependent daemon adapter test

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Later notes from the S93 relay (run-20261026-190634-c1cc, landed 2cb95b9). Owner decision 2026-10-29 (interactive): fix both. (1) A gate that started on a repeated non-adjacent reviewer row (chain A, B, A) can retry row B, which the reviewer already failed. (2) TestAdaptersMapTextAndUsageEvents/claude depends on the environment.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: TestGateWalkStartsAtTheReviewersSeedRow (chain A, B, A with the gate's first record on A does not retry B); TestAdaptersMapTextAndUsageEventsIgnoresTheEnvironment (set REVIEW_FAKE_TOKEN=5abcdefghij in the test environment and the claude subtest still passes).

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Tests first; re-anchor line numbers from the code. 1. engine.go currentEntry (~181-193): when the gate has records, start the walk at the reviewer's seed row if the gate's first record matches that row, instead of row 0; keep appendEntry's adjacent-duplicate rule (runs.go ~314-318). Add the chain A,B,A test that fails first. 2. In live_test.go build the test runner with an explicit empty environment so the redactor (runner.go ~35, 165-166, 192-196) does not read os.Environ(); reproduce the failure first with a dummy REVIEW_FAKE_TOKEN=5abcdefghij on unchanged code, then fix. No UI.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: go test -race -count=1 ./...; go vet ./...; gofmt -l .; slicer check; adj lint.
